subject: Supplier onboarding — remittance info & tax documentation needed
messages:
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@brightblue.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightBlue — vendor intake & remittance information

Hi Naomi,

Thanks for the warm welcome on the call earlier. We are ready to be onboarded as a supplier for Redwood and want to make the vendor setup as smooth as possible. To keep things moving on our end, can you confirm which of the following you need from BrightBlue today?

- Legal entity name and address (we can provide completed intake form)
- W-9 (we're US-based)
- Remit-to address for invoices
- ACH routing/account details OR wire instructions (we prefer ACH)
- Primary billing contact and AP email
- Certificate of insurance (if required)

I've attached our W-9 and a bank verification letter for ACH. If you need anything else (PO template, SOW, or vendor questionnaire), let me know and I'll pull it together.

We'd also appreciate a note on typical PO lead time and whether Redwood requires any specific invoice fields (PO#, invoice date, breakdown, GL code).

Thanks — we'll aim to return anything missing by end of day.

Best,
Liam O'Neal
Head of Finance
BrightBlue Analytics
Attachments: BrightBlue_W9_2026.pdf; BrightBlue_BankLetter_2026.pdf
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@brightblue.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: BrightBlue — vendor intake & remittance information

Hi Dev / Monica,

Forwarding BrightBlue's inbound with attachments. They are ready to be created in the vendor master. Can we confirm the internal checklist and expected turnaround?

Quick checklist I want to capture so nothing is missed:
- Confirm legal entity name matches W-9 (BrightBlue Analytics Inc.)
- Store W-9 and bank letter in vendor folder (Drive link below)
- Create vendor record in NetSuite and tag with region = US
- Set payment method = ACH by default; capture wire as fallback
- Determine required invoice fields and share PO cadence with vendor
- Confirm insurance requirement (procurement policy: >$50k annual needs COI)
- Assign vendor owner and AP contact for invoices

Please add any procurement-specific steps I missed. Liam: letting you know our team will reach out if we need additional KYC. Otherwise we should be able to create the vendor and issue the first PO within 5 business days once final docs are validated.

Drive intake form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1exampleVendorIntake
Ticket: PROC-412 (internal) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-412

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0112
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: BrightBlue — vendor intake & remittance information

Thanks Naomi — copying the steps and next actions below.

Action items (Procurement / Vendor Ops):
1) Verify legal entity on W-9 matches legal name in government registration (we do a quick govsearch).
2) Validate bank letter details (account holder, routing, account number masked in drive). If mismatch, request bank letter on company letterhead signed by bank.
3) Create vendor record in NetSuite (Vendor Type: Service; Payment Terms: Net30; Payment Method: ACH).
4) If vendor expects PO, raise initial PO using estimate values; otherwise route invoices to AP with PO# requirement noted.
5) Flag for COI check only if expected annual spend >$50k — otherwise not needed for now.
6) Add AP contact: ap@brightblue.com (confirm with Liam).

Estimated timeline: 3 business days to validate docs + 2 business days to process vendor creation and issue PO = 5 business days total. If we need SOC2 or additional compliance evidence, add 5–7 business days.

Naomi: I'll start the netsearch and create PROC-412 in our queue. Monica, can you please prepare an onboarding email template with the PO/invoice fields we require?

internal note: mask account numbers in Drive and set folder permission only to Procurement/AP/SalesOps.

- Dev
Dev Patel
Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Neal <liam.oneal@brightblue.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: BrightBlue — vendor intake & remittance information

Thanks all — appreciate the checklist and timeline. A couple quick items: 

- AP email is ap@brightblue.com (confirmed).
- BrightBlue legal name on W-9: BrightBlue Analytics, Inc. — matches our registration.
- We'll redact account number in the bank letter before you upload to Drive and can supply a bank verification letter if you prefer (signed by bank).
- We do expect POs for recurring services; can you confirm whether Redwood will accept a single PO per invoice or requires a PO per subscription line item?

I'll send a follow-up email with the completed intake form and a preferred invoice template by EOD.
